purpose: Exploratory development comparison of binary selection of one fixed repair edit using recorded responses
profile_meaning: Exploratory constraints on inner-validation observed-plus-unknown selected damage, NOT deployment tolerances or safety guarantees. No preferred profile is selected from outer results.
H_constraint_denominator: all inner-validation H rows; selected unknown-baseline or unknown-fixed-outcome rows count towards the constraint
B_constraint_denominator: all inner-validation B rows; selected unknown fixed quality counts towards the constraint
threshold_objective: maximise selected E fixed SA/PA-S outcomes; then minimise H observed-plus-unknown damage, B observed-plus-unknown damage, and total edits, in that order
inner_folds: leave each of the remaining original four folds out in turn
head_selection: pooled inner-validation binary log loss, excluding unknown targets; ties favour stronger regularisation
features: 2048 raw frozen Qwen coordinates; StandardScaler fitted per head on its labelled training rows only
constant_head: when training labels contain fewer than two classes, use (positives+1)/(known+2) and record it
E_endpoint: selected fixed-edit substantive answers / all 89 E prompts; baseline-selected E answers are NOT assigned a behavioural label
E_legacy_baseline: not combined with current E judgements because rubric versions differ
uncertainty: report known, unknown and full-frame bounds; no independence-based p-values across overlapping fitted folds
historical_dynamic: context only; never an input feature or threshold-training signal
acknowledged_limitations: Design follows inspection of these development outcomes; outer validation prevents direct fitting leakage but is not a fresh confirmatory study.
All H rows originate from different source datasets from E/B; source-related shortcuts remain possible.
Only ten known fixed-edit new-harm positives are available; complex models and calibrated safety claims are not supported.
Historical response labels and generation limits remain unchanged.
